title: Contactor current compatibility
description: Contactor rated AC-3 operational current must meet or exceed calculated required contactor rating (1.20 x FLC).

title: Overload range compatibility (Enhanced Tolerance 2026.2)
description: Selected thermal/electronic overload relay setting range [I_min, I_max] must provide >= 20% lower headroom (I_min <= 0.80 * FLC) and >= 25% upper headroom (I_max >= 1.25 * FLC) for thermal derating and motor service factor.

title: Required protection present
description: When motor branch short-circuit protection is required, an approved MPCB or branch protective device must be selected.

title: Catalog component active
description: All selected components must be active in the catalog (no obsolete or discontinued items).
condition: all(c.active == true for c in selected_components)

title: Voltage rating adequacy
description: All power components must have rated operational voltage Ue >= system supply voltage.
condition: all(c.rated_voltage >= system.voltage_v for c in power_components)

title: Main Isolator sizing
description: Main incoming switch disconnector must be rated for at least 125% of motor full load current.

title: Enclosure spatial allowance
description: Total component mounting footprint must not exceed 70% of usable enclosure backplate area to allow wiring ducts and heat dissipation.

title: Control circuit voltage compatibility
description: Contactor coil and pilot devices must match control transformer secondary voltage (24V).
